notes: Each fixture is built with `sh evals/fixtures/<name>.sh <dest>` into a fresh git repo (base commit plus this session's changes). `session` is the simulated session history the executor is told it has. The executor cannot ask the user: it pre-approves the deletions and keep/drop answers stated in `session`, and writes any question it would have asked to outputs/questions.md.
